title: Senior Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Ruby on Rails Developer
Locations: Culver City, CA | SF Bay Area, CA | Austin, TX

Job Description:
We are seeking a Senior Ruby on Rails Developer (Ex-Apple preferred) to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications. The ideal candidate will lead technical initiatives, collaborate across teams, and ensure delivery of robust, secure, and efficient solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain web applications using Ruby on Rails

  • Architect and implement RESTful APIs and backend services

  • Optimize for performance, scalability, and security

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, UX, QA)

  • Lead code reviews, mentor team members, and drive best practices

  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint planning

Required Skills:

  • 10+ years of Ruby on Rails development experience

  • Strong knowledge of MVC architecture and RESTful API design

  • Frontend experience with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (React/jQuery)

  • Database expertise with PostgreSQL/MySQL

  • Hands-on with AWS/Heroku and CI/CD tools

  • Familiarity with RSpec/TDD/BDD and Agile development

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager
Location: Clark County, NV (Local Candidates Only)
Type: Contract | Full-Time

Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to oversee multiple IT initiatives across Network, Infrastructure, Radio Technology, Desktop Services, and Service Desk. The role involves managing 5–15 concurrent projects, ensuring on-time and budget-conscious delivery, and collaborating with diverse stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead technical projects end-to-end, from planning to closeout
  • Manage timelines, risks, and weekly status reporting (via ServiceNow)
  • Facilitate stakeholder meetings, change management board reviews, and cross-department coordination
  • Develop documentation, requirements, schedules, and communications
  • Ensure adoption of modern technologies and create change management/training materials

Requirements:

  • Must reside in Clark County, NV
  • Onsite for first 8 weeks (Mon–Thu, 10-hour shifts), then hybrid (1 day onsite, 3 remote)
  • 10+ years IT experience, with 10+ years in Project Management of technical IT projects
  • 3+ years local government experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects (5–15)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure, Active Directory, Cloud, Disaster Recovery, and Virtual Call Center projects
  • Must pass a criminal background check

Preferred Skills:

  • Balanced Matrix environment experience
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration abilities

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer
Location: Frisco, TX (Onsite)

Job Description:
We are seeking a strong DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in Terraform (IaC), automation, and cloud deployment. The ideal candidate should have experience building scalable and secure AWS-based solutions and supporting CI/CD pipelines.

Key Skills:

  • Expertise in Terraform, including reusable modules and version migrations

  • Experience with AWS services – ECS (Fargate), ALB, Lambda, DynamoDB, Batch, Route53, and Secrets Manager

  • Hands-on with Liquibase setup for DB versioning and Jenkins integration for automated deployments

  • Strong Python and Shell scripting skills for automation and support

  • Ability to provide production support and collaborate with DevOps, QA, and development teams

  • Nice to Have: Knowledge of Java Spring Boot
